title: Video Recorder
layout_order: monitor (top: preview picture left; state light + word, timecode, detail line, stops-at line, sound chips right) | transport buttons Record/Stop then Pause/Resume (always in view) | scroll container: status line with Play / Open folder (after a save) or Get the video codec + Cisco note, message line | Picture: Size, Smoothness, Show my windows | Sound: hint, World (check, level, meter, note), Voice chat (check, level, meter, privacy note), My microphone (check, level, meter, note) | Saving: folder, Change..., Open folder, Stop by itself, free space note. Separate: the REC indicator top right of the viewer window (never in the video)

controls.label: Record / Stop / Saving... (big round button: red dot, red square while recording)
controls.tip: Start recording what you see and hear. Press again to stop and save. / Stop recording and save the video.
controls.action: WolfFloaterRecorder::onRecord(): WolfRecorder::stop() when recording, else WolfRecorder::start(error) (refusal shown as Problem: ...); hides tooltips when the whole window is recorded
source: <string name="record_tip">Start recording what you see and hear. Press again to stop and save.</string>
<string name="stop_tip">Stop recording and save the video.</string>

controls.label: Pause / Resume (round button: two white bars / red dot)
controls.tip: Pause the recording. Nothing is recorded until you press Resume. / Carry on recording, in the same video.
controls.action: WolfFloaterRecorder::onPause(): WolfRecorder::resume() if paused, else WolfRecorder::pause()
source: <string name="pause_tip">Pause the recording. Nothing is recorded until you press Resume.</string>
<string name="resume_tip">Carry on recording, in the same video.</string>

controls.name: transport-button-widget
controls.label: wolf_recorder_transport_button: round button drawn with its word beside it, hover/press wash over the whole target, FocusColor keyboard ring, greyed when disabled; still an LLButton for clicks, keys, tooltips and LEAP clickButton
source: enum Icon { ICON_RECORD, ICON_STOP, ICON_PAUSE, ICON_RESUME };

controls.name: monitor
controls.label: dark monitor: live preview (or 'The picture shows here / while you record'), state light and word READY / STARTING / REC (pulsing red) / PAUSED (amber bars) / SAVING / SAVED (green), timecode hh:mm:ss (saved length after Stop)
source: drawTimecode(time_font, timecode(live ? mSeconds : (mSaved ? mSavedLength : 0.0)), x, y, kMonText);

controls.name: monitor-detail
controls.label: line under the timecode: <size> - <fps> pictures a second (idle) / <fps> pictures a second, <n> skipped (recording) / Nothing is recorded while paused; Stops by itself at <end> (amber in the last 30 s)
controls.when: always; stops-at while recording with a limit

controls.name: monitor-chips
controls.label: Microphone on (red chip) / Voice chat on (grey chip) at the monitor's foot
controls.when: recording, not paused, mic / voice being recorded
source: if (mMicOn) cx += drawChip(cx, cy, getString("chip_mic"), kChipRed, LLColor4::white) + 6;

controls.name: status
controls.label: Press Record to start. Press Stop ... / Starting... / Recording. Press Stop ... / Paused - ... / Recording - it stops by itself at <end>. / Saving the video... / Saved: <file> <size>, <length> long.
source: <string name="ready">Press Record to start. Press Stop when you have finished, and the video is saved.</string>
<string name="recording">Recording. Press Stop to finish and save the video.</string>
<string name="paused">Paused - nothing is being recorded. Press Resume to carry on, or Stop to save.</string>
<string name="near_end">Recording - it stops by itself at [END].</string>

controls.name: message
controls.label: Problem: <error> (caution colour, stays until the next press) or the recorder's notice (sound encoder, length limit, disk nearly full); plus the codec download's own words
source: "). You can change the limit in the Video Recorder window."
"The recording stopped because the disk is nearly full. The video was saved up to "
"The sound encoder could not be started, so this video has no sound."

controls.label: Play
controls.when: after a save (not while the codec is offered)
controls.tip: Play the video you have just saved, in this computer's video player
controls.action: LLWindow::openFile(mSavedFile); if the file is gone, message 'The saved video is no longer in its folder.'
source: tool_tip="Play the video you have just saved, in this computer's video player"
<string name="play_missing">The saved video is no longer in its folder.</string>

controls.label: Open folder (beside Play)
controls.when: after a save (not while the codec is offered)
controls.tip: Show the folder your videos are saved in
